references.text: Describes the five bronze bases for the pillars at the entrance to the tabernacle, which are the same bases mentioned in Exodus 38:30.
Gives instructions for building the bronze altar of burnt offering, which is the same altar mentioned here.
Describes the bronze grating for the altar, which is the same grating mentioned in this verse.
Lists all the bronze utensils of the altar, corresponding to 'all the utensils of the altar' mentioned in this verse.
Mentions the bronze altar with its grating and all its utensils as part of the tabernacle's equipment.
Describes the actual construction of the bronze altar of burnt offering with its grating and utensils.
The altar of burnt offering is placed before the entrance to the tabernacle, showing the connection between the altar and the entrance to the tent of meeting.
Mentions all the altar's utensils that the Levites were to carry, the same utensils made from the bronze.
Complementary descriptions of the bronze objects at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
38:3 details 'all the utensils' mentioned briefly in 38:30.
Repetition in the completion report: 39:39 confirms that the work mentioned in 38:30 was carried out.
The construction detail (38:4) explains the component mentioned in the summary (38:30).
The execution (38:30) confirms the exact fulfillment of God's command in 30:28.
